request: mix: JSONの数値フィールドをスパークラインにする / 標準入力またはファイルから、JSON配列または1行1件のJSON（NDJSON）を読み、-k で指定したキー（a.b のようにドット区切りで入れ子も可）の数値を取り出して、▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ のスパークラインを1行で標準出力に出す。続けて最小値・最大値・件数も表示する。キーがない要素は読み飛ばす。例：「[{"ms":120},{"ms":340},{"ms":90}]」を -k ms で渡すと「▃█▁  min=90 max=340 n=3」と出力する。-k を省略し要素が数値そのものの配列なら、そのまま描く。フラグは -k のみ。コマンド名は jspark

spec.name: jspark
spec.summary: jspark reads a JSON array or NDJSON from a file or stdin, extracts numbers (optionally at a dotted key path) and prints a one-line sparkline with min, max and count.

flags.name: k
flags.help: key path of the number in each element, dot-separated for nesting (e.g. a.b)

behavior: B1: Input is read from the single positional file argument, or from stdin if there is none. More than one positional argument is a usage error: print "jspark: usage: jspark [-k key] [file]" to stderr, exit 2.
B2: If the file cannot be read, print "jspark: " followed by the OS error text to stderr, exit 1.

B3: Format detection: skip leading whitespace; if the first character is '[' the whole input is parsed as one JSON array and its items are the elements. Otherwise every non-blank line is parsed as one JSON value (NDJSON) and each value is an element. Invalid JSON in either mode: print "jspark: invalid JSON" (optionally followed by ": " and a detail) to stderr, exit 1.

B4: With -k set, an element is used only if it is a JSON object and following the key split on '.' through nested objects reaches a JSON number. Anything else (missing key, non-object on the path, string, bool, null, object, array) is skipped silently. With -k omitted, an element is used only if it is itself a JSON number; all others are skipped.
B5: Used values keep input order. n is the count of used values. If n is 0 (including empty or whitespace-only input), print "jspark: no numeric values found" to stderr, exit 1, nothing on stdout.

B6: Let min and max be the smallest and largest used value. Each value v maps to level L = floor((v-min)/(max-min)*7 + 0.5), an integer 0 to 7, drawn as the L-th character (0-based) of the string ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█. If min equals max, every value is drawn as ▁.

B7: On success print to stdout: the sparkline characters, two spaces, then "min=<min> max=<max> n=<n>" and a newline. Numbers are formatted with strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'f', -1, 64) (no trailing zeros, no exponent). Exit 0.
